findings.detail: Appendix C p.20-21: "310 watts x 0.25 hours = 77.5 kWh" and "310 x 0.583 = 180.73 kWh". 310 W for 0.25 h is 77.5 Wh = 0.0775 kWh. summary: CASPS: the paper's own arithmetic reproduces to +0.01% of the published 71,939 kg CO2e (71,943 kg); fixing the errors we documented moves it to 70,495 kg (-2.0%).

trials.source: Griffiths J, Fox L, Williamson PR, on behalf of the Low Carbon Clinical Trials Group. Quantifying the carbon footprint of clinical trials: guidance development and case studies. BMJ Open 2024;14:e075755. doi:10.1136/bmjopen-2023-075755. Online supplemental appendix D (CC BY 4.0).
summary: PRIMETIME: the paper's own arithmetic reproduces to -0.16% of the published 89,360 kg CO2e (89,221 kg); fixing the errors we documented moves it to 89,221 kg (-0.2%).

With TrialPilot's library factors the same activity data give 89,410 kg (P10-P90 89,257-89,499, +0.1% vs published), the difference being factor vintage (DESNZ 2026 vs 2021/2022) rather than method. The TrialPilot engine on the rebuilt design gives 8,995 kg (P10-P90 6,160-12,646, -90%).
